fields.label: Question 1
fields.name: faq_q_1
fields.default_value: What is Aether?

fields.label: Answer 1
fields.name: faq_a_1
fields.default_value: Aether is ITHENA’s Agentic AI-powered advanced analytics platform. It combines Enterprise AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI and Intelligent Automation in one platform, so teams can move from a question to a decision, and from a decision to an action, without crossing a tool boundary.

fields.label: Question 2
fields.name: faq_q_2
fields.default_value: How is Aether different from a traditional BI dashboard?

fields.label: Answer 2
fields.name: faq_a_2
fields.default_value: A traditional dashboard is built to describe what happened and stops there. Aether interprets the data, recommends what to do next, and can initiate the workflow, notification or operational action itself.

fields.label: Question 3
fields.name: faq_q_3
fields.default_value: Can you ask Aether questions in plain English?

fields.label: Answer 3
fields.name: faq_a_3
fields.default_value: Yes. Questions asked in natural language return instant, contextual answers drawn from enterprise data - no query language, no report request and no queue - and where the answer implies an action, Aether can trigger it.

fields.label: Question 4
fields.name: faq_q_4
fields.default_value: Which industries is Aether built for?

fields.label: Answer 4
fields.name: faq_a_4
fields.default_value: Aether is designed for data-intensive, time-sensitive operations, including manufacturing, supply chain, healthcare and finance.

fields.label: Question 5
fields.name: faq_q_5
fields.default_value: Where was Aether featured?

fields.label: Answer 5
fields.name: faq_a_5
fields.default_value: In The Enterprise World, July 2026 edition, under the title “Talking to Your Data: How Aether Turns Enterprise Chaos into Clarity” - its second consecutive feature in the magazine.

fields.label: Question 6
fields.name: faq_q_6
fields.default_value: What does Agentic AI mean in Aether?

fields.label: Answer 6
fields.name: faq_a_6
fields.default_value: Agentic AI recommends and initiates business actions from AI-generated insight, rather than leaving the follow-through to someone’s inbox.

fields.label: Section 1 - body
fields.name: first_content_text_
fields.default_value:
The June issue introduced Aether. July goes further, under the title Talking to Your Data: How Aether Turns Enterprise Chaos into Clarity, and takes up the question that decides whether an analytics investment pays back: not whether the data exists, but how quickly an organisation can move from that data to a decision, and from the decision to an action.

The Enterprise World is a global business magazine covering the organisations, leaders and technologies shaping how businesses operate. The feature runs across a full spread in the July edition.

fields.label: Section 1 - image caption
fields.name: sec1_caption
fields.default_value: The opening spread of the July 2026 feature.

fields.label: Section 2 - eyebrow (also the sub nav label)
fields.name: sec2_eyebrow
fields.default_value: The problem

fields.label: Section 2 - heading
fields.name: sec2_heading
fields.default_value: The data exists. The decision still waits.

fields.label: Section 2 - lede
fields.name: sec2_lede
fields.default_value: Enterprises are not short of dashboards, reports or real-time feeds. What is missing sits between the chart and the thing somebody does about it.

fields.label: Section 2 - body
fields.name: second_content_text
fields.default_value:
Conventional analytics platforms deliver a view and stop there. Interpreting that view, deciding what it means for the shift, the plant or the quarter, and then initiating something - all of it stays manual, and all of it stays with whoever happens to be looking at the screen.

That gap is where the July feature places the real cost of analytics. Every hour spent crossing it is an hour of operational efficiency, productivity and margin that the reporting layer has already been paid for and has not delivered.

It is also a gap most tools have by design. A dashboard is built to describe. Nothing inside it is responsible for the next step.

fields.label: Section 2 - image caption
fields.name: sec2_caption
fields.default_value: A conventional dashboard answers what happened. Reading it, deciding what it means and acting on it all remain someone’s job.

fields.label: Section 3 - eyebrow (also the sub nav label)
fields.name: sec3_eyebrow
fields.default_value: Beyond analytics

fields.label: Section 3 - heading
fields.name: sec3_heading
fields.default_value: Built to act, not only to explain

fields.label: Section 3 - lede
fields.name: sec3_lede
fields.default_value: Aether combines Enterprise AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI and Intelligent Automation in one platform, so the path from question to action does not cross a tool boundary.

fields.label: Section 3 - body
fields.name: sec3_body
fields.default_value:
A user asks in natural language. The platform answers with context drawn from enterprise data rather than a static report, and where the answer implies something should happen, it can trigger the workflow, the notification or the operational action itself.

That is the difference the July feature draws out. Traditional business intelligence describes what is happening. Aether is built to help an organisation determine what to do next, and then to do it.

fields.label: Section 3 - image caption
fields.name: sec3_caption
fields.default_value: A question in plain English, a contextual answer, and a suggested action with one control to run it.

fields.label: Highlight quote (pull quote at the end of the last section)
fields.name: hightlight_quote_para
fields.default_value: The companies pulling ahead are not the ones with the most data. They are the ones who move fastest from data to decision, and from decision to action.

fields.label: Pull quote source

fields.label: What comes next - heading
fields.name: next_heading
fields.default_value: From reporting to intelligent execution

fields.label: What comes next - lede
fields.name: next_lede
fields.default_value: The July feature restates the direction ITHENA is building towards: AI that does not stop at the insight.

fields.label: What comes next - body
fields.name: next_body
fields.default_value:
As enterprises adopt Agentic AI, the useful question stops being how much can be measured and becomes how much can be acted on without a person carrying the result from one system to the next. Aether is ITHENA’s answer to that, and the platform continues to develop against it.

ITHENA values its continued association with The Enterprise World, and remains focused on practical AI that accelerates digital transformation and produces measurable business outcomes rather than another layer of reporting.
